【原视频简介】
I built a massive underground mining facility in my Minecraft survival world.

The goal was to make it feel like an actual working industrial facility, with mining tunnels, machinery, storage, lava, and a huge underground excavation area.

I wanted this one to feel more futuristic and industrial rather than just another underground base, so I went pretty heavy with the purple, white, and black details!

If you want to check out the build for yourself, the schematic is available on my Patreon, along with my full survival world download.
